title: SmartGN - Support & Maintenance
description: Knowledge articles, external gas technicians, tickets, private photographs, technical visits, diagnoses and service ratings. Owns an independent PostgreSQL database and integrates through authenticated HTTP and durable events. Local fixtures do not establish productive external integration.

tags.Knowledge articles: Active preventive guides and their publication.
tags.Technicians: Accredited external gas technicians and availability.
tags.Tickets: Authorized support cases, written resolution and principal-owned closure.
tags.Ticket replies: Chronological written attention and explicit remote resolution.
tags.Ticket photographs: Validated private image uploads and authorized downloads.
tags.Technical visits: Independent visit authorization, appointments, assignments and diagnoses.
tags.Service ratings: One principal-owned rating after eligible attention closes.

operations.description: Requires a current session. Filters active articles by category and applies page/size pagination. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires SUPERADMIN. Stores title, category and the content reference for preventive guidance. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires a current session. Filters active technicians by availability and specialty and applies page/size pagination. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires SUPERADMIN. Records an external gas technician without creating an IAM account. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires a current session. Returns accreditation, specialty, availability and contact data for an active technician. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires SUPERADMIN. Updates accreditation, contact or availability while enforcing active-assignment constraints. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Requires USE_TICKETS for authorized meters, or SUPERADMIN administration. Applies account/meter scope before status filtering and pagination. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires USE_TICKETS on the meter. Principal ownership is resolved on the server; simulated or contradictory identities are rejected. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires USE_TICKETS on the ticket's current owned meter, or SUPERADMIN administration. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires the principal owner. Only RESOLVED tickets can close; financial delivery or payment status does not control technical closure. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires USE_TICKETS or SUPERADMIN. Returns chronological written history with page/size pagination. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

operations.summary: Add a ticket reply or written resolution
operations.description: Requires USE_TICKETS or SUPERADMIN on mutable tickets. Only SUPERADMIN may set resolve=true, and active visits prevent written resolution. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires USE_TICKETS or SUPERADMIN. Returns private photograph metadata with page/size pagination. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Requires USE_TICKETS or SUPERADMIN on a mutable ticket. Requires a real JPEG/PNG file, at most 10 MiB and 25 million decoded pixels; arbitrary object references are rejected. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires access to the parent ticket. Returns the original JPEG/PNG bytes through an authenticated route, not a public storage URL. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires USE_VISITS independently of USE_TICKETS, or SUPERADMIN. Includes preserved technician-assignment history. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Requires USE_VISITS and an unresolved ticket with a valid future availability interval. No advance payment is required; only one active visit is allowed. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Requires SUPERADMIN, a reason and an eligible accredited technician. Preserves previous assignments and prevents simultaneous reservations. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires SUPERADMIN and an assigned visit. Confirms a valid future interval within the requested availability window. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires SUPERADMIN and SCHEDULED state. Records the effective start of attention. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

operations.summary: Complete a visit with its final diagnosis
operations.description: Requires SUPERADMIN and IN_PROGRESS state. Records performed work and final cost once, releases the technician and commits the Billing event locally. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Requires USE_VISITS independently of USE_TICKETS, or SUPERADMIN. Financial references remain absent until verified Billing evidence is received. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires ticket access. Returns the existing rating without changing ticket dates or state. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Requires the principal owner and CLOSED state. Accepts a score from 1 to 5 once per ticket and preserves the original closure timestamp. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Accepts CoverageCalculated for a completed owned visit. Checks final cost against the diagnosis and deduplicates equivalent business content across HTTP and MQTT. Authentication: private service credential; user JWTs are not accepted. Internal routes must remain outside public gateway routing.
